Requirement_Description: The API shall provide a health check endpoint
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return HTTP 201 when the health check is successful

Requirement_Description: The API shall generate an authentication token
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return a valid token when valid credentials are supplied

Requirement_Description: The API shall retrieve all booking IDs
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return a list of booking IDs

Requirement_Description: The API shall allow users to create a booking
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return HTTP 200 and a booking ID when valid booking data is submitted

Requirement_Description: The API shall retrieve a booking by ID
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return the corresponding booking details

Requirement_Description: The API shall allow authorized users to update bookings
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return HTTP 200 when a booking is successfully updated

Requirement_Description: The API shall allow authorized users to partially update bookings
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall update only the specified fields

Requirement_Description: The API shall allow authorized users to delete bookings
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return HTTP 201 when a booking is successfully deleted

Requirement_Description: The API shall handle invalid booking identifiers
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall return an appropriate error response

Requirement_Description: The API shall reject invalid authentication credentials
Acceptance_Criteria: The API shall not generate a valid authentication token
